_comment: Open-WebUI model picker curation — version-controlled source of truth.
ADR-013: Cloud Model Tier Refresh.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS INSTEAD OF HELM VALUES:
Open-WebUI exposes per-connection model filtering via OLLAMA_API_CONFIGS /
OPENAI_API_CONFIGS, but upstream never implemented JSON parsing for those env
vars (open-webui issue #19017, closed as not planned). Model visibility therefore
lives only in the Open-WebUI DB on the NFS PVC. This manifest plus
scripts/open-webui/apply-model-curation.sh reproduces that state declaratively
and is the recovery path if the PVC is ever lost.
Apply with: ./scripts/open-webui/apply-model-curation.sh
MODEL PARAMS:
`model_params` is applied to every kept model via /api/v1/models/import.
`function_calling: legacy` is required for web search to actually run — on the
default 'native' setting Open-WebUI only offers the model a web_search tool and
lets it decide, and that tool is skipped entirely unless the request carries a
websocket session_id. Legacy makes Exa results deterministic. See the README.
PER-MODEL OVERRIDES (ADR-022):
A keep entry may carry `capabilities` (stored as meta.capabilities) and `params`
(merged over model_params). local-uncensored uses this to switch off builtin tools
and web search: builtin tools made small local models slow, and web search would
send every prompt to Exa, which defeats the point of a local model.
local-uncensored stays on legacy (ADR-023). Native was tested 2026-11-24: with tools present and
thinking off, Gemma looped on empty <|channel>thought blocks until max tokens on 1 of 3 prompts;
with thinking on it never called a tool. Legacy + Zimi's deep_search answered correctly.
